loader_handoff.basis: Declared discovery input: a zero-filled loader handoff in a free RAM gap, not a capture. The kernel copies 0x5c0 bytes from it. The boot-reason word at +0x140 is 0x40, which selects boot reason 1 from GFX 50R table 0x104e8dc. Its physical meaning is not measured. Kernel entry bypasses the boot ROM.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased. No flash capture exists.

nor.basis: Declared discovery input: a Micron NOR on chip select 0 with 256-byte pages and its datasheet configuration reset 0xff. The chip part and all latencies are not measured; the ticks are synthetic.

adc_input.basis: Measured GFX 50R 3.11 loader handoff +0x188 channels 0-9, read through the resident service; channels 10-11 are declared 512, not measured.

gpio_input.basis: Declared zero external GPIO levels for discovery; not measured pin levels.

sd_card.basis: Declared 4 GiB SDHC card for ROM-to-SD execution; size, RCA and FAT32 geometry are synthetic.

usb_cable.basis: Declared disconnected high-speed USB input; VBUS bank 1 bit 14 is assumed from the shared controller wiring, not measured.

sub_cpu.basis: Measured GFX 50R 3.11 loader handoff +0x140 value 0x10, read through the resident service; selects boot reason 2. Other peer registers are declared zero.

pll_input.basis: Declared loader-inherited PLL state for kernel-entry discovery: PLLs 0 and 3 running, like the shared XPP stage-2 configuration. This is an assumed input, not a GFX 50R measurement; ROM execution may reprogram the clock bank.
